map.输入水压、磨料流量、材料类型与厚度，评估水刀切割能力并估算切割速度与每米耗时。: Enter water pressure, abrasive flow, material type and thickness to assess waterjet cutting capacity and estimate cutting speed and time per meter.
map.可切厚度 ∝ (水压)^0.5 × 磨料流量: Cuttable thickness is proportional to (water pressure)^0.5 times abrasive flow
map.基于水刀(AWJ)切割能力模型：可切厚度随射流压力（约平方根）与磨料流量增大；结: Based on a waterjet (AWJ) cutting capacity model: cuttable thickness grows with jet pressure (about square root) and abrasive flow; combined with material type and thickness it recommends process parameters, for waterjet equipment selection.
map.💡 切割速度 v ≈ K×(P/300)^1.5×(A/300) ÷ (厚度×材: Tip: cutting speed v about K times (P/300)^1.5 times (A/300) / (thickness times material machinability index); P is water pressure (MPa), A is abrasive flow (g/min), K is an empirical coefficient.
map.常用磨料为石榴砂（80目），磨料流量影响切割速度与质量: Common abrasive is garnet (80 mesh); abrasive flow affects cutting speed and quality
map.水压一般 300~400MPa，超高压（600MPa+）可显著提升效率: Water pressure is generally 300 to 400 MPa; ultra-high pressure (600 MPa plus) significantly improves efficiency
map.材料可加工指数反映切割难度，越小越易切: The material machinability index reflects cutting difficulty; smaller is easier to cut
map.本工具为经验估算，实际速度受喷嘴、水质、磨料粒度等影响: This tool is an empirical estimate; actual speed is affected by nozzle, water quality and abrasive grain size
map.📚 深度解析：水刀切割能力计算（切割速度与可切厚度）: In-depth: Waterjet Cutting Capacity (cutting speed and cuttable thickness)
map.工艺预算：由水压、磨料流量与厚度估算切割速度和每米耗时: Process budgeting: estimate cutting speed and time per meter from pressure, abrasive flow and thickness
map.材料评估：比较不同材料的可加工指数与厚度上限: Material assessment: compare machinability index and thickness limits across materials
map.参数优化：评估提高水压或磨料流量对效率的提升: Parameter optimization: assess the efficiency gain from raising pressure or abrasive flow
map.算法：经验切割速度 v = 5000×(水压/300)^1.5×(磨料流量/30: Algorithm: empirical cutting speed v = 5000 times (pressure/300)^1.5 times (abrasive flow/300) / (thickness times machinability index M) (mm/min); maximum cuttable thickness is taken at v = 5 mm/min, bounded by the material maxT limit; time per meter = 1000 / v (minutes); cutting length per hour = v times 60 / 1000 (m/h). Capacity grading: thickness over maxT is beyond material limit, v at least 100 excellent, at least 30 good, at least 10 slow, at least 5 difficult, otherwise not recommended. Machinability index M: glass 0.8, aluminum alloy 1.0, stone 1.5, composite 1.8, copper 2.0, carbon steel 2.5, stainless 3.0, titanium alloy 3.5, ceramic 4.0.
map.例：碳钢（M=2.5、maxT=100mm）、350MPa、磨料 300g/mi: Example: carbon steel (M 2.5, maxT 100 mm), 350 MPa, abrasive 300 g/min, thickness 10 mm gives cutting speed 252.03 mm/min, 3 min 58 s per meter, 15.12 m per hour, recommended max thickness 100 mm (bounded by limit), capacity excellent. Aluminum alloy (M 1.0, maxT 150 mm), 380 MPa, 400 g/min, 50 mm gives speed 190.08 mm/min, 5 min 16 s per meter, 11.40 m per hour. Ceramic (M 4.0, maxT 80 mm), 100 mm gives speed only 15.75 mm/min and thickness exceeds the limit, judged as beyond material limit.
map.可加工指数 M 是什么？: What is the machinability index M?
map.是材料对水刀切割难易程度的经验系数，M 越大越难切、同参数下速度越低。数值会随设: It is an empirical coefficient of how difficult a material is to cut by waterjet; larger M is harder to cut and gives lower speed at the same parameters. Values vary with equipment, nozzle and abrasive conditions; calibrate with trial cuts before quoting.
map.为什么提高水压能显著提速？: Why does raising pressure significantly speed up cutting?
map.速度与 (P/300)^1.5 成正比，压力从 300 提到 380MPa 时系: Speed is proportional to (P/300)^1.5; raising pressure from 300 to 380 MPa raises the factor from 1 to about 1.43, speeding up by about 43 percent. But higher pressure wears the high-pressure pump and nozzle faster, so trade off between efficiency and consumable cost.
map.水刀切割能力计算器基于经验模型，输入水压、磨料流量、材料类型与厚度，估算切割速度: The waterjet cutting capacity calculator, based on an empirical model, takes water pressure, abrasive flow, material type and thickness to estimate cutting speed, time per meter and maximum cuttable thickness, and assesses cutting feasibility. It suits waterjet process parameter pre-selection.
